patches.value: On (ℝ^n\C)×int J all positive-order derivatives of u vanish. For every r∈int J, the scalar functions e(·,r), e_t(·,r), u_t·u_tt, u_t·Δ_xu, and for every spatial j the functions ∂_{x_j}u·∂_{x_j}u_t, u_t·∂_{x_jx_j}u, g_j=u_t·∂_{x_j}u, and ∂_{x_j}g_j are continuous, vanish outside C, and have compact topological support contained in C; g_j is smooth.

patches.new: For every real b, the function b 1_Q is integrable on ℝ^n. In particular e(·,t) is integrable for every t>0.

value.statement: Let A,B be measurable spaces with s-finite measures μ,ν, and V a normed additive commutative group and real normed space. For f:A×B→V integrable for μ×ν, one has ∫_{A×B}f d(μ×ν)=∫_B(∫_A f(a,b)dμ(a))dν(b).

binders.type: normed additive commutative group and real normed space

hypotheses: A,B,μ,ν,V have the stated structures; μ and ν are s-finite.

patches.old: f=the coordinate insertion pullback of (∂_{x_j}g)1_Q; use the symmetric ordering if necessary so the j-coordinate integral is performed first.
patches.new: f=the coordinate insertion pullback of (∂_{x_j}g)1_Q. The source integrates first in A, exactly the j-th coordinate, and then in B.
